notes: s017 takes the repeated 'the epistle' under rule 102, which rule 103 names explicitly as the case where an article rather than a spent noun licenses the supplied nominal.
s006 takes the supplied demonstrative 'this' under rule 60; the ASV's own gloss note 'Greek the' confirms the article is what the word answers to.

s013 Λαοδικέων carries no article of its own, so the supplied 'the' is a rule 7 helper on the anarthrous genitive and 'of' rides with it (rules 51 and 57); the outer article keeps its own 'the' across the interposed genitive.
